quickref.status: BBG 2013 default; named in 2026 Steam text
quickref.look: Coral-red octagonal tube, pinched in the middle and flared at both ends (#DE604D in the 2026 trailer, #A14243 in a 2013 capture); a row of glowing orange window panels (#FF941F); grey metal collars; grey-checkered rear flare; black bore. Shouldered with the muzzle forward. Not green: the green in the trailer is the Green Oliver skin, and the 'hazard stripes' are his bullet bandolier.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: 2 shots before reloading [Fan-wiki]; planned stats were a 1 s rate of fire, 3 s reload and 1000 u/s rocket [Fan-wiki]. Rocket and muzzle look not observed.
quickref.impact_end_result: Explosive area damage (AOE) [Game text via wiki]; the user easily blows himself up [Fan-wiki]. Explosion look unverified; use the general BBG grammar: faceted yellow-orange fireball, octagonal ground ring, faceted grey puff. Kills can gib.

quickref.look: Ordinary deaths: the victim goes limp and topples as one intact body, with no blood; the corpse stays at least about 1-2 s.
quickref.impact_end_result: Explosive and radiation deaths break the body into 4-7 clean chunks (head, torso, limbs, backpack or flag) thrown up through a yellow faceted blast. Three Joule pickups drop at the death site [Fan-wiki].

quickref.look: Gamma Ray: short yellow beam [Fan-wiki]. Gernobyl: lime goo puddles (#A1D22C) [Observed]. Radiation Rod: placed glowing field [Fan-wiki].
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Continuous beam, globs of goo, or a placed field
quickref.impact_end_result: A yellow-black radiation trefoil grows above the victim's head with Geiger clicks; at 100% the victim explodes in a yellow-white blast and gibs, hurting others nearby.

quickref.look: Bone rifle with an animal-skull scope [Fan-wiki]
quickref.firing_and_projectile: A single red stream-like bullet [Fan-wiki]; a thin pale zigzag trail seen in the trailer [Observed]
quickref.impact_end_result: A translucent red buffalo skull (#FE2B35) rises from the victim, who topples [Observed; identification is Inference]. A white-lock hit is an instant-kill headshot; the kill feed shows 'HEAD SHOT' with a red crosshair over the victim's portrait.

quickref.look: Olive nuke with a yellow-black radiation trefoil, strapped to Tillman's jetpack
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Rises on a yellow-white flame trail, then falls down a yellow light column onto the locked target
quickref.impact_end_result: A translucent yellow faceted dome fills the area and flings gibs, followed by a mushroom cloud of translucent white faceted puffs.
A huge, opaque, blinding white sphere wrapped in jagged cyan lightning (#80FFFE) [Observed]

quickref.look: A small pink orb floating at Botch's side [Fan-wiki]
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Grows into a large barrier of compact hexagons
quickref.impact_end_result: A magenta faceted honeycomb dome (#D457EB / #CD20ED); everyone inside takes 50% more damage; no overhead icon.

quickref.look: Mother of Nature: large purple berry. Chaos Toss: skeletal hand lobbing a gleaming orb [Fan-wiki].
quickref.impact_end_result: A purple (Riggs) or green (Botch) poison cloud; a small purple or green skull over the victim; damage over time.

quickref.firing_and_projectile: Lobs a small pink Huggable-like head that stays solid after hitting [Fan-wiki]
quickref.impact_end_result: Victim fully stunned for 2.6 s; a blue Nugg bird circles above the dazed victim [Fan-wiki; icon Observed].

quickref.weapon: Glue Bomb / Bind Field / Phantom Hug
quickref.look: Glue Bomb: small purple sticky blob. Bind Field: prickly ball with purple nodes and green seams. Phantom Hug: glowing pink Huggable-shaped energy.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Thrown or lobbed in an arc
quickref.impact_end_result: Slowed or held in place; blue concentric ground rings (Glue Bomb) [Observed]; a yellow 'Z' icon over slowed players [Fan-wiki].

quickref.look: Ice-cream sandwich with an angry brown bear face, red eyes and yellow teeth
quickref.impact_end_result: Damage boost for 20 s (doubles or triples; the wiki conflicts). A swirling magenta-pink electric ring circles the player (#E76FE6).

quickref.look: Four green shields orbit the player [Fan-wiki]; translucent green heater-shields seen in a low-resolution image [Observed]
quickref.impact_end_result: Immune to damage for 10 s (4.5 s after respawning); falling off the map can still kill.

quickref.look: Health Pack: white-grey box with an orange cross. Imperial Basket Grande: red basket of golden fried chunks.
quickref.impact_end_result: Health Pack heals up to 35 (respawns in 45 s); Imperial Basket Grande adds 50% of max health and can overheal to 200% (respawns in 60 s) [Fan-wiki].

quickref.look: Blue lightning bolt on a dark hexagon
quickref.impact_end_result: Three drop where a player dies, worth 25 Joules each, and vanish after 10 s; '+25' lines appear in the HUD feed.

quickref.weapon: Peek A Boo / So Fly / Double Rainbow!
quickref.look: Rainbow streak effects in red, yellow and green (#E35254 / #E3B935 / #41A13E)
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Peek A Boo: an upward rainbow burst, then invisibility with neon team lines. So Fly: the Huggable flies forward in a stream of rainbow shards. Double Rainbow!: two rainbows spin around the user.
quickref.impact_end_result: Each effect is identified only by Inference. The trailer's 3.3 s rainbow fan is not shown to be a death.

soul_corrections.current_text: The Bearzooka is drawn as a green, hazard-striped tube [Observed; Inference].
soul_corrections.correction: In BBG the Bearzooka is a coral-red octagonal tube (~#DE604D in the 2026 trailer, ~#A14243 in a 2013 capture) with a row of glowing orange window panels (~#FF941F), grey metal collars and a grey-checkered flared rear [Observed]. This matches the wiki's 'rocket launcher with red and orange lines' [Fan-wiki]. Green Bearzookas belong to BB Zombies and BB-1 [Fan-wiki].
soul_corrections.evidence: Wiki infobox capture Photo_19-04-13_12_02_26_PM.png (2013), saved at /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-thallo-site/91c60972-6d3f-51de-9a92-c1d563bcf5a4/scratchpad/weapons/dl/combat-vfx/png/Photo_19-04-13_12_02_26_PM.png. Official 2026 Steam trailer 3.9-4.8 s (dl/combat-vfx/tr/bz_full_4.3.png and sheets/bz_sheet.jpg). Bearzooka_Concept.png. In that trailer shot the green is the Green Oliver skin's fur (GreenSkin.png) and the yellow-and-black 'hazard stripes' are his brass-bullet bandolier.

soul_corrections.current_text: He holds a chunky assault rifle and carries a green hazard-striped launcher tube on his back.
soul_corrections.correction: He holds a chunky assault rifle and carries a coral-red launcher tube with glowing orange window panels, grey metal collars and a grey-checkered flared end.
soul_corrections.evidence: Same as the previous correction: Photo_19-04-13_12_02_26_PM.png, trailer 3.9-4.8 s, Bearzooka_Concept.png.

soul_corrections.current_text: A green-and-dark-grey harness with grey clips [Observed] and a small green backpack [Inference].
soul_corrections.correction: Check before changing. The BBG 2013 in-game default shows a brass-bullet bandolier across the chest and red (team-colour) headband, wristbands and ankle bands with red gem studs [Observed]. The backpack seen in play is pale grey-lilac (~#A88EA4) with team-colour trim [Observed]. If the green harness comes from a specific 2012 card, cite it and keep it only for that era; the unsampled 'harness green #4E6B35' in line 49 depends on this.
soul_corrections.evidence: Wiki default-skin render OliverSkin.png (uploaded 2013-10-15), saved at dl/combat-vfx/png/OliverSkin.png. Trailer frame dl/combat-vfx/tr/bz_full_4.3.png (backpack sampled at #A88EA4 on the Green Oliver skin).

soul_corrections.current_text: No blood, gore or organs: bears throw sparks, Huggables burst into rainbow confetti, robots shed bolts.
soul_corrections.correction: Keep the rule but label it, with the observed baseline: in BBG a normal death is an intact ragdoll collapse, and explosive or radiation deaths break the body into a few clean toy-like chunks [Observed]. BBG News dresses those chunks as sparks (bears), rainbow fluff (Huggables) and bolts (robots) [BBG News invention]. No source shows confetti.
soul_corrections.evidence: Official 2026 trailer at 4.9-5.6 s, 8.9-9.0 s, 12.6-14.9 s, 26.5-27.8 s and 31.7-32.7 s; Steam screenshots screen_03.jpg and screen_04.jpg. The prior research notes' fact-check also removed 'confetti' as unsourced.

soul_corrections.correction: Huggable "gore" stays rainbow fluff or confetti [BBG News invention]. SkyVu's rainbow Huggable blood comes from the earlier PvE games [Fan-wiki]; in BBG footage a killed Huggable breaks into plush pieces with gold sparkles [Observed].
soul_corrections.evidence: Wiki Huggable page ('rainbow blood that flies out from the body vertically when the Huggable is beheaded') and Headlights trivia (BB-1/BBZ/BB0 death animation); trailer 8.9 s; HuggyBiteMeCR.png (rainbow-smeared bear traps).

open_questions: Does the 2026 build keep ragdolls and gibbing? Both appear in the official 2026 trailer, but the capture build is unverified. Check the Oct 19-26 Steam Next Fest demo or the JustNubz showcase if it can be viewed.
Is the thick black ink outline in the 2026 Steam screenshots and trailer an in-game rendering change or a marketing filter? 2013 captures have no outline.
Does a Huggable spray rainbow when it dies in BBG? The rainbow fan at 3.3-3.8 s in the trailer is most likely Peek A Boo; BBG footage shows Huggables breaking into plush chunks.
What do the Bearzooka's rocket, muzzle flash and explosion look like? No frame found; wiki demonstration video AZt_huguhzc seen only as thumbnails.
Do gibbed bears show the 'pink and red flesh' the wiki describes for Tillman? Not seen in any frame.
How do the Frozen state (S'no Matter, Let It Cold), the poison skull icons and the Drain Field look? No images found.
Is there a respawn or spawn-in effect or a death cam, and how long do corpses stay on screen?
What does the green 'OH BABY' HUD text mean? Possibly a killstreak call.

Which weapons made the trailer effects: the pink beam that irradiated the orange Huggable at 7-9 s, B-1000's kill of the green Soldier at 4.9 s, and the orange sky cone with octagonal shockwave rings at 52.6 s?
Does the Bearscream Sandwich double or triple damage? The wiki's Bearscream Sandwich and Pick-Ups pages conflict.
